# RFC 6570 URI Template fixtures

These fixtures are sourced from the official
[`uri-templates/uritemplate-test`](https://github.com/uri-templates/uritemplate-test)
repository.

Included files:

- `spec-examples.json`
- `spec-examples-by-section.json`
- `extended-tests.json`
- `negative-tests.json`
- `LICENSE`

The upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved verbatim in `LICENSE`. Keep the
included fixtures and license in sync when refreshing the suite.
